nodes.name: AuthScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Client-only decorative 3D network scene (react-three-fiber) rendered on the auth pages, showing animated nodes/links with travelling data pulses. Fades in via onCreated and reports readiness through an onReady callback.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses low-power WebGL settings (antialias off, dpr capped at 1.5) since it's purely decorative chrome behind the auth forms.

nodes.name: auth.css
nodes.summary: Input chrome and decorative keyframe animations scoped to [data-auth], giving HeroUI fields and the hand-rolled password input on the sign-in/sign-up pages an identical white-well, signal-ring focus style.
nodes.languageNotes: Scoped to [data-auth] rather than [data-wicloud-app] so the same rules don't leak into the dashboard's HeroUI fields; respects prefers-reduced-motion for all keyframes.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Static route rendering the 'confirm your address' instructional page shown after sign-up, telling the visitor to check their inbox before the dashboard becomes accessible.

nodes.name: apple-icon.tsx
nodes.summary: Build-time generated 180x180 Apple touch icon (via next/og ImageResponse), reusing the same signal-green ring-and-satellite brand mark as the favicon, scaled up for iOS's home-screen size.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Site-wide design tokens and global styles: the cool/signal color palette as CSS variables, ground-adaptive accent resolution (--accent-text/--signal-text/--pt-*) for light vs dark sections, the hero/auth texture gradients, scrollbar styling, section rhythm classes, and shared animation keyframes (hero-rise, underline-draw, skeleton-sweep, target-flash).
nodes.languageNotes: Ground-adaptive tokens (--accent-text, --signal-text, --pt-*) are re-declared per selector (.section-ink, .bg-abyss, .on-dark, .on-dark-raised) so the same utility class resolves to a WCAG-compliant value on whichever background it's nested in, rather than needing separate light/dark component variants.

nodes.name: icon.tsx
nodes.summary: Build-time generated 32x32 favicon (via next/og ImageResponse) drawing a signal-green orbit ring with a satellite dot on a near-black ground, echoing the 3D hero globe's shape.

nodes.name: drizzle.config.ts
nodes.summary: Drizzle Kit configuration pointing at the Postgres schema and migrations folder, using the unpooled Neon connection string for DDL to avoid PgBouncer prepared-statement errors.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Flat ESLint configuration extending Next.js's core-web-vitals and TypeScript presets, with default build-output directories re-declared as ignored.

nodes.name: neon.ts
nodes.summary: Neon infrastructure-as-code declaration applied via `pnpm neon:deploy`: disables Neon Auth (Better Auth runs against the same Postgres instead) and provisions a private 'documents' object-storage bucket for dashboard attachments.

nodes.name: next.config.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js configuration setting standalone server output (for the slim Docker runtime image) and the allowlist of remote image hostnames (Apple's macbook-pro CDN, Unsplash, a placeholder CDN).

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Minimal PostCSS configuration enabling only the @tailwindcss/postcss plugin for Tailwind v4 processing.

nodes.name: proxy.ts
nodes.summary: Next 16 proxy (the renamed middleware.ts) that optimistically checks for a Better Auth session cookie on /dashboard and /admin routes, redirecting anonymous requests to /connexion with a ?next= return path. Deliberately not the real authorization boundary — that's lib/guard.ts.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads the session cookie by literal name instead of Better Auth's getSessionCookie helper, because better-auth/cookies' dev-source export condition breaks `next dev` resolution.

nodes.name: lp_video.webm
nodes.summary: Full-bleed WebM footage used by the homepage UniverseReveal section, playing continuously inside the SVG-masked WICLOUD wordmark as the scroll-driven letter zoom resolves.

nodes.name: ocr_video.webm
nodes.summary: Presentation WebM footage for the OCR solution, played by SolutionVideoReveal's pinned-scroll stretch-to-fullbleed sequence on the OCR sub-landing page.

nodes.name: docker-push.ps1
nodes.summary: Windows/PowerShell deployment script that loads Docker Hub credentials from .env.local, builds the WICLOUD image tagged with the git short SHA (or a supplied -Tag) plus :latest, logs in, and pushes both tags.

nodes.name: docker-push.sh
nodes.summary: Bash equivalent of docker-push.ps1 for Linux/macOS: parses .env.local for Docker Hub credentials without sourcing it (avoiding shell-injection from stray characters), builds, tags with the git short SHA or a supplied argument, and pushes both tags.

nodes.name: vitest.config.mts
nodes.summary: Vitest configuration using jsdom, the tsconfig-paths plugin (so tests resolve the @/* alias like the app does) and the React plugin, restricted to the project's own *.test.ts(x)/*.spec.ts(x) files.

nodes.name: DataPulse
nodes.summary: Animates a small emissive cube travelling along a given Catmull-Rom curve using useFrame, representing a pulse of data flowing along one network link.

nodes.name: Network
nodes.summary: Renders the decorative node-and-link network group: four curved links each with a DataPulse, four detailed node boxes (etched sub-panels), a central hub box, and a subtle continuous rotation/bob animation via useFrame.

nodes.name: AuthScene
nodes.summary: Default-exported component mounting the react-three-fiber Canvas with the Network scene; fades the canvas in once WebGL context creation completes and calls the onReady callback at that point.

nodes.name: VerificationPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported page component rendering the post-sign-up 'confirm your email' instructions and a link back to /connexion.

nodes.name: AppleIcon
nodes.summary: Default-exported generator that returns an ImageResponse drawing the 180x180 Apple touch icon: a signal-green ring with a satellite dot on a near-black square.

nodes.name: Icon
nodes.summary: Default-exported generator that returns an ImageResponse drawing the 32x32 favicon: a scaled-down version of the same signal-green ring-and-satellite mark.

nodes.name: proxy
nodes.summary: Checks the request for a Better Auth session cookie (plain or __Secure- prefixed); passes the request through if present, otherwise redirects to /connexion with a next= return path. Matched only against /dashboard/:path* and /admin/:path* via the exported config.
